answer: Each challenge binds its parameters to a future drand quicknet pulse, whose threshold-BLS signature makes the seed unpredictable until release and publicly verifiable afterward. Participants commit before the pulse, then reveal a response tied to that seed and current task state. A vertex cannot stockpile answers, wander across identities, or farm offline; the lotus check rejects stale or duplicated proofs, raising the cost of automated Sybil swarms without treating randomness alone as identity.
